assumptions: mdctpsnr = mdctpsnr::mdct_psnr_srgb8 (lib.rs:1990-2003 -> score_impl 2003-2360). LINEAR build: sRGB8 -> exact EOTF LUT -> linear BT.601 YCbCr, gamma knee on Y only.
Ingress per px (lib.rs:1959-1989): 3 LUT gathers + 3 fma (Y) + 3 fma/mul (Cb) + 3 (Cr) + cmp + pow knee on Y (~high path) + 3 stores.

Sliding windowed 8x8 DCT (lib.rs:1231-1457, 1475-1525): per position per component per image at (W-8)x(H-7) positions: 64-elem block copy, column-mean tree (56 adds + 7 + div), window toward mean (b*w + avg*(1-w): mul2 add1 x64), two-pass scaled AAN: 16 aan_1d calls x (add 24, fma 6, mul 1), scatter 64 stores. Positions = (W-8)*(H-7) per component.

Per band per line (192 bands/img): push_row (lib.rs:983-1058): mapped = |in|*vis^e via powf (e==1 shortcut exists; counted pow 1) + symmetric 5-tap conv_add (2 add + 1 mul + 2 fma); compute_mask (lib.rs:515-548, 1072-1130): m0*(s04) mul+add, fma(m1,s13), fma(m2,d2), fma(sum,1/25,base), rcp + 1 NR step (mul3 add1), coeff = mid*vis mul1. Band rows: input w8 wide, mask/coeff w13 wide.

EXTENDED_FILTER: Y-DC band computes 4 sub-band 5x5 low/high filters (compute_lowpass, lib.rs:640-700): per elem per subband 5 rows x (2 mul + 3 fma) + 4 acc adds + store; mask fixup borrows (0,1)/(1,0)/(1,1) masks: add1 fma2.

Measure (lib.rs:1775-1807, 1851-1906): per measured position (W-13)x(H-12), 195 terms (64 bands x 3 comps; Y-DC = 4 lowpass terms instead of 1): err = (|r-d|*visbase)*max(rm,dm): sub1 abs1 mul2 cmp1, then p = (err*err^2)*err^2: mul4, errorline *= exp(-p): exp1 mul1.
Score: -20*log10(error/(w*h*3)) with w=W-13, h=H-13 (reference's h-quirk kept), plus per-line error accumulation adds over errorline.
Errorline reset + per-line sum folds counted in measure stage's add.

stages.name: EOTF LUT + linear BT.601 YCbCr + Y knee
sliding windowed 8x8 AAN DCT, 3 comps
stages.notes: per pos: block gather 64 + col-mean 63add+div + window 64x(mul2+add1->counted mul in ingress of stage)... conservatively: 16 aan_1d (add384 fma96 mul16) + window (add64 mul128) + sums (add63) + div1 + copies

stages.name: per-band |in|*vis^expon + 5-tap sym h-conv (192 bands)
stages.notes: pow counted on all bands (e=1 shortcut is a minority)

stages.name: errorline *= exp(-(|r-d|*vis*max(mask))^3.5), 195 terms
stages.notes: 195 terms x (sub+abs+2mul+cmp / mul4+exp+mul): product accumulation into errorline then line-sum adds folded in
